items.claim: lengthTable gave a straight segment length 0 when its squared length overflowed or underflowed
items.note: and a769170623 switched it to geom's shared length rule

items.claim: 3D `len`/`distance` overflowed and underflowed, with knock-on effects in `intersectRayPlane`, `nearestPointOnLine` and `nearestPointsRayLine`
Quadratic and NURBS curve reps zeroed a small curve's curvature on an absolute threshold
items.note: all three reps now share `curvatureFromDerivatives`, which also stops speed³ overflowing past about 1e100 and underflowing under about 1e-100 (that was hitting the cubic too)

items.claim: pathCrossings never found a cubic segment crossing itself
nearestPointsRayLine paired a zero-direction line with the ray's origin
pathCrossings never tested a segment against itself
items.note: duplicate of A's pathCrossings finding, fixed 56f1699ac2

items.claim: Curve reps' `toPath` wrote world coordinates into a Float32Array with no `origin`
items.note: the new `polygonPathFrom` helper is also used by booleans' `writePath` and the booleans adapter, which spelled out the same steps

items.claim: A subpath opened after `Z` with no `M` reused the previous subpath's anchor id, so anchor queries answered on the wrong subpath
items.note: the strict call is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: that subpath's first segment has no start anchor, so it takes no anchor range and no segment-fraction share

items.claim: 3D lengths and line lengths in the length table disagreed with geom's 2D `distance` in the last bit
items.note: My first `Math.hypot` version broke `points.test.ts` "agree across the tiers", which holds the 2D, nd and 3D results to the same bits. The new `lengthOf3` uses the same steps as the 2D rule, and ray3's rescale now asks `squaresHeld` instead of using a second threshold. This repairs my own earlier commits, so it isn't counted below.
